notes: Self-contained v1.3.0 stable source track. Enables Oodle/PlM support in the pinned Rust UID remapper; host migration now stops a running server, publishes the migrated world under Pal/Saved/SaveGames/0, atomically updates GameUserSettings.ini DedicatedServerName, and restarts only when the server was previously running. Includes persistent serialized new-player starter gifts.
